question_intents: How to operate the Qursor MAP interface
data.summary: This user guide provides comprehensive instructions for the Qursor MAP application, covering initial login, application settings, and the main dashboard interface for managing locations, maps, and AGVs. It details workflows for task execution, AGV diagnostics, station management, and the handling of diagnostic messages and user-reported issues.
